resources.string: Sends prompts that keep getting longer (from %1$d to %2$d characters) and measures the time to the first token. The slope is the cost of each extra thousand characters of context. Sizes that do not fit the engine are skipped.
A slope close to zero means the engine takes the prompt almost for free (cloud); a high one means prefill shows (on-device).
